correctness.rationale: Four tensor Laplacian projectors give every transition entry. The formal distance-two numerator has positive coefficients. Exact Bernstein/translation certificates establish all seven admissible low-size cases. A rational negative-diagonal witness and three positive-coefficient parameter-quadrant expansions exhaust all larger cases. A separate square-edge sign argument uses a positive quadratic discriminant certificate and a strict m=38 witness; Descartes establishes two roots. The exact arithmetic verifier replayed all 147 Bernstein coefficients, quadrant expansions, 361 witness comparisons and 536 full-matrix identities; finite tests do not carry the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The line graph of a complete bipartite network is a canonical two-factor mixing geometry, relevant for categorical product diffusion. The complete all-timestep positivity threshold for arbitrary rectangular aspect ratio is a natural classification, and the independently sharp square 37/38 adjacent-entry sign transition distinguishes local transition positivity from global Markov positivity. Both are mathematically motivated exact structural phase transitions, not finite table recomputations.
